name: model
character: The reaction-kinetics model behind the chem.* gate rows: seven inferred pools released by elicitors the pipeline already measures, cleared by first-order loss with Michaelis-Menten saturation, and depleted by their own release. It integrates expectation, tonal tension, groove and the virtual ear; it does not measure a molecule.
provenance: Every number in this file is a starting value [start], chosen so the model's qualitative behaviour is right (a build creates drive, a repeated arrival spends it, the ending recovers) and never fitted to annotated data. docs/NEUROCHEMICAL-AFFECT-PLAN.md sections 3.2-3.4 give the rationale; section 6 gives the corpus calibration that would replace them. No chem.* row may FAIL on these numbers (section 4.1).

DA_ant.reads_as: dopaminergic anticipation: wanting the next event
DA_ant.why: [start] Salimpoor et al. 2011 measured caudate dopamine release during anticipation, not during the peak; k and tau_rec put the build on a 4-12 s scale a listener can feel.

DA_con.why: [start] Salimpoor 2011 also measured ventral-striatal release at the peak; the faster clearance and stronger depletion are what make a second identical drop weaker.

NE.why: [start] an arousal state inferred from surprise, roughness and onset rate; no assay is involved, so this pool is a summary of the audio, not a transmitter.

CORT.why: [start] tension, roughness, masking and ungrounded surprise accumulate; consonance and recovery clear it. Tier C because cortisol is confounded by context and time of day (de Witte 2019, d = 0.35 hormonal).

OXT.reads_as: affiliative warmth: something voice-like to bond with
OXT.why: [start] legato, vocal presence, consonance, slow tempo and a stable pulse raise it. Tier C: peripheral oxytocin assays disagree on direction (Ooishi 2017 raised, choir singing 2017 lowered).

END.reads_as: effort and entrainment: something for the body to lock to
END.why: [start] the Witek syncopation window, low end and onset rate raise it; the pain-threshold work (Tarr 2015, Pearce 2016) is a proxy for exertion and synchrony, not a pleasure meter.

PSNS.reads_as: parasympathetic recovery: the piece comes down
PSNS.why: [start] a measured fall in arousal, consonance and legato raise it, tension and a new arrival cut it. Recovery from listening alone is weak evidence (g = 0.15, n.s., 2022 meta-analysis), so this pool can only advise.

build.why: [start] a rise over 4-12 s is long enough to be an anticipation and short enough to still point at the arrival.

proximity.why: [start] the declared arrival is felt inside 20 s; further away the ramp is flat and the pool does not rise.

arrival.why: [start] contrast is read on 3 s either side, and a 6 dB / one-octave / two-onsets-per-second change is what counts as a full arrival.

recovery.why: [start] the last fifth of the piece is where a come-down is measurable; a 30 s cue at 6 s.

slow_tempo.why: [start] the slow-tempo listening studies use relaxing selections well under 100 BPM (Ooishi 2017).

silence.why: [start] a hole is scored over 2 s: shorter is articulation, longer is a rest.

density.why: [start] onsets per second over 2 s, against 4 per second as the busiest a groove reads; absolute on purpose, because a per-piece normalisation would give a static pad the same density as a drum pattern.

consonance.why: [start] the adjacent-pitch-class product of a plain triad sits near 0.05 and a chromatic cluster near 0.30; 0.22 is the scale's ceiling.

surprise.why: [start] the repo's own grounding rule (expectation.ungrounded_share) uses 4.2 bits as a high-surprise note.

pulse.why: [lit] Witek et al. 2014 find the most moving syncopation in the middle of the range, not at either end; the figures are the repo's feel.witek window.

low_end.why: [start] below C3 (MIDI 48) is the weight region a body feels rather than hears.

build.why: the lead time before the strongest declared arrival, and whether the anticipation pool rises through that lead-up; below the event floor there is no arrival to build towards and the row says so [start]

arrival.why: [start] contrast is read on 3 s either side of the hit, the shortest span that holds a bar in most tempi

stress.why: [start] a load above half its own maximum that has not fallen to 40 % of it within 10 s is carried, not resolved

recovery.why: [start] the come-down is measured over the last fifth of the piece

variety.why: [start] a pool 'moves' when it spans a quarter of its own maximum and reaches 0.1; a stretch is flat when the seven pools together move less than 5 % of their mean step

anchors.why: [start] each connection dimension divides its measured value by this anchor and clips to 0..1, so a mood target written as 0.7 means 'about 70 % of the level the row's own starting bar calls high'.

levers.reward_build: lengthen the build before the hit, withhold the tonic, or move the arrival later in the score
levers.reward_arrival: put a real change at the hit (timbre, low end, a voice, a register change) instead of a level nudge
levers.stress_load: resolve the dominant, thin the cluster, or add a breath where the roughness runs
levers.affiliation: give the lead a singable legato contour, add a voice or a hum, or slow the harmonic rhythm
levers.motor_drive: syncopate the cell into the 0.4-4.8 BSI window, or give the kick and bass one owner
levers.recovery: write a resolution section: slower, consonant, thinner, with a real cadence or a declared cliff
levers.arc_variety: change the state between sections and delete a duplicate arrival

confidence.A: held-out predictive validity on a corpus, with a shuffled-label control at chance. No chem.* row starts here.
confidence.B: a mechanism with causal or imaging evidence, modelled from elicitors the pipeline measures (anticipation, consummation, arousal).
confidence.C: inferred from peripheral assays that disagree, or from a proxy (stress, affiliation, effort, recovery). Advisory only.
